4152.title: Grouped ACP selections fail parsing
4152.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP parser validates top-level groups as leaf choices, rejecting model groups and discarding other grouped choices.
4152.proposedFix: Validate grouped selections at the wire boundary and normalize them for existing internal consumers.
4152.caveats: Direct parser reproduction; vendor integration and UI were not exercised. No automatic fix because the accepted public wire schema must change.
